remarks: Welcome to this terrific one level unit at Marina Bay! Enjoy living by the water in this move-in ready unit offering a large living room with hardwood floors and a fireplace. The kitchen with white cabinetry is centrally located and adjacent to the large dining room, also with hardwood floors and sliding doors out to the back patio, perfect for outdoor dining! The primary bedroom has new flooring and a nicely updated full bathroom with walk-in shower, as well as a walk-in closet. The guest bedroom is nicely sized and also has new flooring. The living room and dining room were painted and there are new plantation shutters in the living room, dining room and both bedrooms. Marina Bay has a terrific pool and clubhouse building overlooking Long Island Sound and is conveniently located close to beaches, shopping and dynamic downtown Stamford. A wonderful place to live!!
